reason: Cirrose means bearing a tendril, which is what tendrilous means.
Caudiculate means having a caudicle, as in orchid pollinia.
'Low' makes the shape flat or shallow, a different form from plain conical.
Vinaceous means wine-coloured, which is close to reddish purple. This is an approximation. It could instead go to dark purplish red, as burgundy does.
Not disarticulating means the structure does not break apart at joints, and the negated 'jointed' value stands for that. I could not read the definition of FLOPO_0991154 to confirm.
Corneous means horny and hard. Hard keeps the main sense, though it loses the horn-like texture.
Lacerate is defined as an irregularly cut margin, as if torn. That matches irregularly incised.
Aseptate means without septa.
Multistratose means having many layers, which is stratified.
Rugulate means finely wrinkled. Rugose is the nearest PATO term.
The shape is still triangular. 'Long' only adds the proportion.
Cross-striolate means finely striped across the surface.
Setulose means bearing small bristles, which are stiff. Pubescent means soft hairs, so these are different indumentum types.
Inermes means unarmed, with no spines or prickles, which is 'not spiny'.
Unpleasantly scented is the definition of foetid.
Purple tinged means tinged with purple. It maps to the colour purple, and the 'tinged' degree is lost.
The word gives a count of veins. 'Vascular bundle present' loses the number and says nothing a veined part would not already say.
Paleate means bearing paleae, chaffy scales or bracts. The flower bract term lists chaff as a synonym.
Loop-connected veins are joined in loops, which is anastomosing.
This is a variant spelling of loculicidal.
Scant means few or sparse.
Stipellate means having stipels.
The word means erect and also pressed against the surface. Appressed alone loses 'erect'.
Racemoid means raceme-like.
Twisted is the synonym of torsioned, so 'not twisted' is its negation.
Bulged only means swollen or protruding. Gibbous means swollen on one side, which is narrower.
Checkered means a pattern of squares, which is tessellated.
Burgundy is a dark purplish red.
Spiculose means covered with small spicules, which are minute hard points. This is near muricate.
Converging means leaning toward each other. Connivent also says the parts touch without fusing, and the word 'converging' does not say that. Convergent would be the better target if one exists.
Nipple-shaped is mammillate or papillate, which is close to papillary.
Pocket-shaped means pouched, which is saccate.
Cormose means bearing a corm.
Compacted means condensed, and PATO lists compressed as a synonym of condensed.
Sward-forming means forming a dense turf, which is the same sense as mat-forming.
Deltoid means triangular, so the term is lanceolate-triangular.
Glomeruliform means in a dense cluster, which is aggregated.
Non-aristate means without an awn.
Elevated means raised above the surface, which is prominent. The negation carries over.
Obsolescent means nearly vanished or rudimentary, which is vestigial.
Assurgent means curving upward, which is ascending.
Stilt roots are prop roots.
Laticiferous means having latex-carrying cells (laticifers).
Domatiate means having domatia.
Bunched means clustered, and clustered is a synonym of aggregated.
Non-fibrous is the negation of fibrous.
Not fibrous is the negation of fibrous.
Not scarious is the negation of scarious.
Not stoloniferous means no stolons.
Forked means bifurcated, so the negation carries over.
